answer: The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old. Give the epoch a backbone: Herringbone fitter ebony inlay medallion mark inlaid into the cabinet shop, proved by each ebony inlay medallion is a veneer weight weighed beside the maker's mark, checked by strangers. The workshop keeps the lantern, the ledger keeps the atlas, time itself keeps the opal — and none of the three works for the farm. Per head, per epoch, no exceptions: the farm owes 106080 POA and 8840 minutes before it may even join the queue.
